rule_or_pattern: Latin homoglyph word 'Ha' (U+0048 U+0061) between Cyrillic/date tokens -> Cyrillic 'На' (regex: (?<![A-Za-z])Ha(?= \d)); more generally map a Latin-letter-only token made only of Cyrillic look-alike letters, inside a Cyrillic line, to Cyrillic
notes: This is a single-column Bulgarian entomology journal with Latin species names. The cyrillic text, including the old orthography (ѣ, ж, ъ), is read correctly in the random lines. The column_crossing/column_merge flags are false: the page image shows one column, and lines 28-31, 34, 38 and 40 are whole correct lines. The systematic error is the preposition 'На' written with Latin 'Ha' (25, 32, 35, 37). Google also drops the long dash '—' throughout (10 'metridae — 49' -> 'metridae 49'; 15, 17, 21, 29), which no text rule can restore; treat it as the pool-wide Google dash habit.
